Message:
KVM: Use vfree for memory allocated by vcalloc()/__vcalloc()

commit 37b2a6510a48("KVM: use __vcalloc for very large allocations")
replaced kvzalloc()/kvcalloc() with vcalloc(), but didn't replace kvfree()
with vfree().
